data.title: Rio Tinto celebrates 60 years in Western Australia
data.description: KARRATHA, Australia-- Rio Tinto is commemorating its 60th year in Western Australia by remembering the significant milestone of the initial iron ore shipment from Dampier to Japan. This historic event took place on August 22, 1966, when the ship Houn Maru set sail. A groundbreaking agreement with Japanese steel mills was established for the purchase of 65.5 million tonnes of iron ore within a 15-year timeframe. This deal, regarded as the largest export agreement in Australia at that time, provided the necessary commercial stability for the development of the Pilbara region. Celebrating six decades of presence, Rio Tinto acknowledges the enduring impact of this key moment.

data.title: Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. Provides Required Disclosure
data.description: Monroe Township, New Jersey - On August 21, 2026, Ocean Power Technologies, Inc. (NYSE American: OPTT), a key player in maritime operational infrastructure and autonomous ocean systems, made an announcement regarding its Financial Statements in the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ending on April 30, 2026. The audit report from its Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm included an explanatory paragraph highlighting a going concern qualification. This disclosure is mandated by Section 610(b) of the NYSE American Company Guide. It is important to note that there have been no alterations to any of the Company’s filings for the fiscal year ending April 30, 2026.

data.title: First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt Announces Results  of Annual General and Special Meeting
data.description: Today, First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt disclosed the outcomes of its Annual General and Special Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting highlighted the approval of key resolutions, including the election of a new board of directors and the appointment of auditors for the upcoming fiscal year. Shareholders also greenlit executive compensation plans and ratified the company's stock option program. The meeting garnered a significant turnout, with over 85% of shareholders in attendance either in person or by proxy.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig Advises TPG AG-Led Consortium on $628M Industrial Real Estate Portfolio Acquisition
data.description: In a recent development from New York on August 21, 2026, Greenberg Traurig, LLP, a prominent global law firm, successfully facilitated the acquisition of a substantial 53-building industrial real estate portfolio. The acquisition, valued at an impressive $628 million, was led by a consortium spearheaded by TPG AG. The purchased portfolio includes an extensive 5.4 million square feet of space primarily utilized for distribution and logistics purposes.

data.title: National Press Club Statement on the firing of Stars and Stripes editor
data.description: On August 21, 2026, Mark Schoeff Jr., the President of the National Press Club, issued a statement condemning the dismissal of Erik Slavin, the editor of Stars and Stripes. Schoeff Jr. criticized the Pentagon, alleging it is trying to control military media coverage. This move has sparked controversy and calls for immediate action to address this issue.

data.title: Metropolitan Issues Statement on Release of 2027-2028 Guidelines, ROD for Colorado River Operations
data.description: In Los Angeles, the General Manager of Metropolitan Water District, Shivaji Deshmukh, has commented on the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation's recent release. The statement addresses the Colorado River 2027-2028 Operating Guidelines, the Record of Decision for the Post-2026 Colorado River Operations Final EIS, and the August 24-month study. The guidelines and Record of Decision underscore the need for 3.2 million acre-feet in contributions from the Lower Basin by 2028.

data.title: Elseland Showcases New Possibilities for AI Game Creation with 20 Original Titles
data.description: Singapore-based company Elseland has introduced 20 innovative new titles showcasing the potential of AI in game development. These games, covering genres like match 3, puzzle, arcade, action, hypercasual, and interactive narrative, were crafted with AI technology handling aspects such as visual design, world building, gameplay, and storytelling. By integrating AI throughout the production pipeline, Elseland can efficiently experiment with various concepts, try out diverse creative approaches, and bring them to life as fully functional games in a shorter timeframe.

data.title: Back to School with Zum: The Most Important Commute in America Begins Again
data.description: Zum, a prominent player in student transportation, is starting the 2026-27 school year with new initiatives and existing collaborations. The kickoff took place on August 21, 2026, in Redwood City, California. Various Zum teams nationwide are gearing up for the academic year with launches and partnerships lined up for the students' benefit. This includes drivers, district personnel, and other key stakeholders involved in ensuring smooth student mobility. The company's focus on improving student transportation services will likely impact a significant number of students across the country in the upcoming school year.
